title: Support the animals
headline:
A little kindness.
An everyday difference.
introduction: The animals depend on care every day. Help Critter Creek continue its work by supporting the animals who call the ranch home.
alt: A blue parrot looks toward the camera from its enclosure.

sections.heading: Keep the care going
sections.body: Support for Toby's Legacy Critter Creek Ranch Foundation helps its mission to provide continued care for the animals on site. Your generosity becomes part of that ongoing commitment.

sections.heading: Talk to us about giving
sections.body: Contact the ranch to find out how to make a gift or ask about current needs. The team can help you choose an appropriate way to support its work.

sections.heading: Give your time, too
sections.body: A helping hand matters. If volunteering is a better fit for you, explore the volunteer page and get in touch about current opportunities.
